title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: 四合院(siheyuan)是中国一种传统的住宅建筑，其特点是房屋建造在一个院子的四周，将院子合围在中间。四合院通常冬暖夏凉，环境舒适，尤其适合大家庭居住。四合院在中国各地有多种类型，其中以北京的四合院最为典型。如今，随着现代城市的发展，传统的四合院已逐渐减少，但因其独特的建筑风格，四合院对中国文化的传承和中国历史的研究具有重要意义。
reference: The siheyuan is a traditional Chinese residential building, characterized by houses built on the four sides of a courtyard, enclosing it in the middle. It is usually warm in winter and cool in summer, providing a comfortable environment that is especially suitable for large families. There are various types of siheyuan across China, among which the ones in Beijing are the most typical. Nowadays, with the development of modern cities, traditional siheyuan have gradually decreased; however, owing to their unique architectural style, they remain of great significance to the inheritance of Chinese culture and the study of Chinese history.
